restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday: 2^96 groups with shared m0..m14; enumerate all 2^32 values of m15.
Digests by partial evaluation; K_full is the full 256-bit digest. Sparse set indexes by top 140 bits of K_full but stores K_full.
On occupied index: compare full K_full (Word ops only). Compressions are NOT charged on 140-bit-only collisions.
Only when stored K_full equals new K_full: rebuild messages and run two full reference compressions; halt on success. At most V_max=8 such verification attempts per run (heuristic-free cap).
Candidate ledger 287 Word ops/msg (inner 252 = FF xor only; pack 14; table 21; no spare). Plus T_ver<=16 and negligible index-hit compare charge.
Repair of refuted c1454726 fatal F-COST-VERIFY-OMITTED; not a reopen of FF-mask/spare dispute.
Success 0.39 under H1-grouped-digests; Unkeyed BLAKE3-256; 2 rounds; classical 256-bit word RAM.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random independent group prefixes (m0..m14) and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for bounding F1 (no full collision), F2 (140-bit index displacement with different K_full), and F4 (V_max exhausted before verifying a true collision), up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3932) and claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: This grouped birthday search with N=2^128, 140-bit indexing, full-K store/compare, V_max=8, and the stated partial-evaluation map. Does not assert differentials or sub-birthday structure.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer matched-scale digest-xor-mask experiments at widths 16, 20, and 24 with N_t^2/2^w=1, plus single-group stress, are extrapolated to full 256-bit collision statistics under H1 across ~232-240 untested bits.
heuristics.limitations: H1 unproved. Truncation cannot detect almost-permutations. V_max is a hard resource cap; under adversarial maps success may drop (time bound still holds). No full-scale collision known.
